capabilities: Open a random file containing a to-do item
Open a random to-do item at its position
Match to-do items with a custom JavaScript regex pattern
Show an optional status bar to-do counter
Assign hotkeys to the random file and random item commands
extras: The default to-do pattern is an ellipsis (todo, ..., ??? are examples); users must set the pattern and hotkeys in settings.
intentEvidence: Same as Open Random note core plugin, but with this one you will only land in files
motivation: The author wanted to minimize clicks; the core random note plugin made them re-roll the dice too often to skip finished notes.
problem: The core Random note command lands in finished or irrelevant notes, forcing repeated re-rolls before finding actionable work.

relations.evidence: It has similar functional but focuses on different use cases

summary: Plugin that jumps to a random note or random to-do item matched by a custom regex marker, with an optional status bar counter.
